findings.evidence: Hom.lean:290 has `image_tangentHom := (image_hom (A := A.tangent) i).trans (image_ofBaseSet i)`. A grep finds no matching chart lemma; the only use of `chart_hom.*chart_ofBaseSet` is Duality.lean:152.
findings.fix: Add a `@[simp]` lemma `FiniteBundleAtlas.chart_tangentHom` in `FiniteBundleAtlas/Hom.lean` next to `image_tangentHom`. Then simplify `hco` and the other `hchart` rewrites with it.
findings.issue: `hchart : A.tangentHom.chart i = A.chart i` is a reusable fact proved inline as `(chart_hom (A := A.tangent) i).trans (chart_ofBaseSet i)`. Because it is not a lemma, the proof needs `rw [hchart] at h₂`, `hchart ▸ (himage hzi).2` followed by `rwa [hchart]` in `hco`, and a `rw [mem_preimage, hchart, ...]`.

findings.evidence: See the `rw [hθz, h₁, h₂, h₃, map_smul, ...]` block before `field_simp [hρ z hz]`. The PR description gives this proof as 50 lines.
findings.fix: Factor out the pointwise identity `ρ z • ⟪ζ x, s x⟫ = θ z (coord s z 1)` at the point read at `z` as its own lemma, combining `hco` with `hRg`. Close the remaining goal with `simp [...]` or `grind` instead of an ordered rewrite list.
findings.issue: The final step of `exists_zeroOneForm_chart` is a 12-step `rw` chain (`hθz, h₁, h₂, h₃, map_smul, complexAntilinearPartL_eq_self_iff.2 hw, hilbertSchmidtInner_smul_left, ← hco η, ← hco s, hη z hzi, hRg z hz _ hw`) followed by `field_simp`. It depends on exact term shapes, so it will break if a Mathlib or Tau Ceti lemma is renamed. The proof is also at the 50-line limit.

findings.evidence: The same term appears in all three diff hunks (ChartSection.lean and Density.lean twice). A grep of FiniteBundleAtlas/ for an existing lemma of this kind finds no matches.
findings.fix: Add `FiniteBundleAtlas.dom_subset_dom_inter_preimage_image : A.dom i ⊆ A.dom i ∩ A.chart i ⁻¹' A.image i` in Basic.lean. At all three call sites, pass `hψi.trans (A.dom_subset_dom_inter_preimage_image i)`.
findings.issue: The generalized `contMDiff_smul_chartSection` makes every old-style caller re-prove `tsupport ψ ⊆ A.dom i ∩ A.chart i ⁻¹' A.image i` with the same term `fun x hx ↦ ⟨hψi hx, A.mem_image.2 ⟨x, hψi hx, rfl⟩⟩`. This copy is at ChartSection.lean:63; the same proof appears at Sobolev/Density.lean:148 and Sobolev/Density.lean:415.

summary: The PR proves the one-form chart identification inline instead of as a lemma next to `image_tangentHom`, which forces `▸`/`rwa` workarounds and a long rewrite chain in `exists_zeroOneForm_chart`. The generalized `contMDiff_smul_chartSection` makes three call sites repeat the same subset proof.
